topic: Markey's five-site triangular-lattice growth identity and Shannon's fixed-radius circle counts
title: Proof of Markey's five-site growth identity and Shannon's region formulas

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Markey's conjecture in OEIS A400701, FORMULA, revision 30 (October 20, 2026), that the five-site growth count exceeds Shannon's circle-vertex count at the same iteration n > 1 by 4n+7, using residue-class points in expanding hexagons. Counting incidences on the same shapes also proves Shannon's conjectured region formulas and gives the curved-edge counts. The argument proves the recorded formulas for three and four initial sites and the generating functions recorded by Irvine.
summary: An exact hexagonal-shape description proves A400701(n)=A374338(n)+4n+7 for every n >= 2 and the two-, three-, four- and five-site formulas. Circle incidences give the A374337 region formulas, A374339 edge counts and a generating function for newly drawn circles. Pfoertner's relation is established for the coefficients of Barker's recorded A265676 rational series; its geometric petal interpretation is separate.
